heroes.name: Julius
heroes.description: Fluffiest defender with an impenetrable shield. He protects, he attacks, and most of all, he naps.
heroes.best_synergy: Judge, Isaac, Nebula, Eva, Lara Croft, Ginger, Polaris, Astrid and Lucas. Shields, extra speed, and the level-30 Relic skill strengthen these synergies by adding Armor Penetration for each active shield.
heroes.relic_overview: With his Relic, Julius becomes an even stronger cornerstone for Progress teams. He protects vulnerable allies more effectively, turns broken shields into healing, removes negative effects, and grants substantial Armor Penetration. This improves both team survivability and allied damage.

skills.name: Meowsterpiece of Defense
skills.description: Protects the team with a shield that absorbs any damage. When the shield is destroyed or expires, Julius and all allies are healed. Way of Progress heroes receive twice as much healing.

relic_boost.alexandre_tip: Agora, quebrar qualquer escudo cura os aliados protegidos: se o escudo protegia apenas um herói, somente ele recebe cura; se protegia toda a equipe, todos são curados. A cura do escudo da habilidade suprema já faz parte do efeito base.
relic_boost.description: When a shield is destroyed or expires, the hero protected by it recovers Health. Does not apply to the Meowsterpiece of Defense skill. Way of Progress heroes receive twice as much healing.

skills.name: Copycat Device
skills.description: Passive: every time Julius gains a shield, his Physical Attack increases until the end of battle, based on his Physical Attack at the start of battle. Active: grants Julius a shield that absorbs any damage. If it survives for 5 seconds, its remaining durability is copied to each ally.
skills.physical_attack_increase: 8% of Physical Attack at the start of battle

skills.name: Nine-Lives Engine
skills.description: When a shield on Julius or an ally is destroyed or expires, that hero gains Armor and Magic Defense for 1.5 seconds and all negative effects are removed.

relic_boost.alexandre_tip: Julius também remove efeitos negativos dos aliados quando aplica um escudo. Isso fortalece a equipe contra Iris e outros heróis com muitos efeitos de controle, como Satori, Tempus e Phobos.
relic_boost.description: Whenever Julius or an ally gains a shield, all negative effects are removed from that hero.

skills.name: Purrfect Reflexes
skills.description: Speeds up attacks and skills of all allies protected by a shield. Way of Progress heroes receive an increased bonus.

skills.name: Pawsitive Influence
skills.alexandre_tip: Julius concede um escudo adicional ao aliado com menos Vida. Quanto mais Vida esse aliado já perdeu, mais forte fica o escudo: uma ótima forma de salvar o herói mais vulnerável!
skills.description: Every 13 seconds, grants the most injured ally a shield that absorbs any damage. The more Health the ally has lost, the stronger the shield.

skills.name: Defensive Lunge
skills.alexandre_tip: Enquanto Julius e seus aliados têm escudos, recebem Penetração de Armadura adicional, com um bônus separado para cada escudo ativo no herói. Isso não transforma Julius em uma máquina de causar dano, mas oferece aos atiradores do Progresso uma fonte consistente de Penetração de Armadura que faz muita diferença.
skills.description: While Julius or his allies have a shield, their Armor Penetration is increased for each active shield.

realm_skills.name: Cosmic Armor
realm_skills.description: Julius shields the army with his technology, increasing the defense of all troops by 12%.

realm_skills.name: Star Wanderer's Shield
realm_skills.description: All troops' attacks have a 30% chance to grant a shield that absorbs 8% damage for 2 turns.

class_skill.target: Ally with the lowest Health percentage, including the tank itself
class_skill.description: Increases the target's Armor and Magic Defense based on Julius's maximum Health.

heroes.strong_against_note: According to Alexandre's updated Relic notes, the level-20 shield application cleanse strengthens Julius against these four mages.

Adds shields and supports physical pressure in the Progress core.

best_teams.label: Way of Progress Core
best_teams.testing_note: Alexandre's first recommended team: Julius, Judge, Nebula, Isaac, and Eva. Julius and Judge provide layered protection; Nebula supplies attack buffs, cleansing, and healing; Eva deals very high damage, and Isaac adds shields and physical support.

best_teams.label: Julius, Judge, Folio, Isaac, and Polaris
best_teams.testing_note: Alexandre's second recommended team in the updated Relic notes.

best_teams.label: Julius Team #4
best_teams.testing_note: Alexandre's favorite team for attacking Kayla and Aidan formations.

reported_win_rate.note: Reported personal result; no battle sample or test conditions supplied. Not a guaranteed matchup win rate.

observations: Nos meus testes de PvP, Julius tem impressionado. Eva, Julius, Nebula e Juiz parecem formar o melhor núcleo: Eva causa um dano muito alto nessa combinação.
Nebula aumenta o ataque, limpa efeitos negativos e cura. Sem ela, esse combo não funciona tão bem e pode decepcionar.

Juiz protege o aliado mais ao fundo e o mais à frente. Nessa formação, os escudos protegem Eva na retaguarda e reforçam Julius na linha de frente contra Leonel, que destrói escudos. Usar Julius sem Juiz pode trazer problemas contra Leonel.
Isaac, Polaris, Lara Croft, Crow e outros heróis podem ocupar a quinta vaga.
Com Relíquias fortes em Eva e Julius, o combo venceu equipes que considero entre as mais fortes da atualidade, mesmo com menos poder: cerca de 970 mil contra adversários com mais de 1 milhão.
battle_notes.testing_note: Resultados pessoais relatados por Alexandre, incluindo vitórias contra outros times fortes. A quinta vaga de cada batalha, os níveis exatos das Relíquias e a quantidade de testes não foram informados.
